test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height. C is taller than only two other friends. E is shorter than only one friend. B is shorter than C but taller than A. D is shorter than F. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F.

1) C is taller than only two other friends. 

__ > __ > __ > C > __ > __

2) E is shorter than only one friend. 

__ > E > __ > C > __ > __

3) B is shorter than C but taller than A. 

__ > E > __ > C > B > A

4) D is shorter than F. 

F > E > D > C > B > A

So, 'A' is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
